cmdDescrp: Sets up the bot for your server

flows.panelNotPosted: I couldn't post the panel in <#{channelId}>, so any previous panel stays where it was. Give me View Channel and Send Messages there, then run this step again.
flows.oldPanelNotRemoved: The new panel is up, but I couldn't delete the old one in {channels}. Delete it by hand so members don't see two.
flows.autoCreateLeftovers: I couldn't delete these channels from the failed setup: {channels}. Delete them by hand before trying again.
flows.staffRoleMissing: Pick a role to turn on the global staff role, or uncheck **Enable Staff Role** to turn it off.
flows.rulesNextStep: Next step: run `/rules-setup setup` with <#{channelId}> as the channel and your verified role to post the rules message. Rules shows **In Progress** until then.
